tei:div.tei:p: "$ (459)༄༅// ni gu ma'i smon lam bka' rgya ma bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya pra ṇi dhā na rā dza na ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po zhes bya ba// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// thugs rje'i phrin las phun sum tshogs pa yis// bdag gis smon lam 'di dag thams cad kun// ji ltar btab pa bzhin tu 'grub par shog /'di nas bzung ste rnam pa thams cad du// mos gus tshad med bla ma mnyes byed cing*// rnam dag lus ngag longs spyod mkha' mnyam mchod// skad cig mi 'bral phrin las rgyas byed shog /tshe rabs kun tu nyan bshad sgom sgrub tshe// log pa'i slob dpon de bzhin bla ma ngan// grogs ngan sbyin bdag ngan dang mi phrad cing*// bla ma mchog bsten byang chub der thob shog /skye ba kun tu rigs bzang nad med cing*// dbyangs snyan gzugs mdzes gzi brjid stobs ldan nas// tshe ring 'khor dang longs spyod chos rnams kun// lhun gyis grub cing kun gyis bkur bar shog /gang du skyes pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du// sems can rnams kyis mthong thos dran reg tshe// mdzes shing yid 'ong lta bas mi ngoms shing*// mi mthun phyogs bral kun dang mthun par shog /bdag ni mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyi// mgon skyabs re gnas dpung gnyen gyur nas kyang*// gang la gang 'dod re ba thams cad kun// tshul bzhin bdag gis ma lus skong bar shog /bdag la phan par 'dod pa'i grogs rnams dang*// lus ngag yid gsum smon lam gcig tu sbyang*// dus 'di nas bzung skad cig mi 'bral zhing*// dag snang bde skyid phun sum tshogs par shog /gang skyes yid bzhin nor bur bdag (460)gyur nas// dgos 'dod thams cad yid la bsam ma thag /phun sum tshogs pa dpag med char babs nas// sems can thams cad bde la 'god par shog

/bdag ni gnas pa'i sa phyogs thams cad du// 'gro kun nad gdon 'thab rtsod dbul phongs bral// tshe ring nad med chos dang longs spyod ldan// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shog /skye ba 'di dang skye ba thams cad du// longs spyod nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes nas// sbyin pa rnam bzhi phyogs bcur gtong byed cing*// pha rol phyin bcus 'gro kun smin grol shog /'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus thams cad la// chags thogs med pa'i shes rab phun tshogs nas// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus kun// skad cig tsam gyis thams cad mngon gyur shog /bdag ni bslab gsum dri med legs brgyan zhing*// rtsod bral lhar bcas 'jig rten mchod cing bstod// tshul khrims mchog la 'gro ba kun 'god cing*// legs pa'i yon tan ma lus rab rdzogs shog /ri khrod dgon par chog shes zas gos ldan// phyi nang bar chad skad cig mi 'byung bar// nyams rtogs mthar phyin phrin las tshad med kyis// 'gro rnams ma lus smin cing grol byed shog /lha 'dre stobs ldan dregs can ma lus kun// bsnyen sgrub rbad bskul skad cig mi dgos par// srog snying phul zhing bran bzhin nyan pa dang*// mthu stobs phun tshogs bstan pa bsrung bar shog /bdag gis byams dang snying rje mngon gyur te/ khams gsum sems can ma lus thams cad kun// gcig la gcig 'tshe'i gnod pa rab zhi nas// bu gcig ma bzhin brtse bas gnas par shog /(561)nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed gyur pa'i tshe// gnad gcod mi 'byung chos sku mngon gyur nas// gzugs sku rang shar gzhan don lhun grub cing*// sku gdung ring bsrel 'gro ba 'dren par shog /rgyal ba'i zhing khams ma lus thams cad du// sangs rgyas bskal pa'i rdul snyed rgya mtsho la// kun bzang mchod sprin nam mkha' mnyam pa yis// bskal pa rgya mtshor bdag gis mchod byed shog

/zhing khams rnam dag rgya mtshor mngon gyur te// spyod pa rnam dag shes rab tshad med kyis// chos rnams rgya mtsho thams cad rab mthong nas// ye shes rgya mtsho ma lus rtogs par shog /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung dbyangs mngon gyur nas// nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tshangs pa'i dbyangs sgrogs shing*// 'gro rnams skad du bdag gis chos bstan nas// sems can ma lus sangs rgyas sar 'god shog /kun bzang sgyu ma'i rnam thar ji bzhin tu// mtha' bral sgyu ma'i ting 'dzin mngon gyur nas// sangs rgyas sku dang zhing khams ma lus kun// rdul gcig steng du skad cig 'grub par shog /sems can khams dang rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' dang*// nam mkha'i mtha' dang chos dbyings tshad med lhag /bdag gi smon lam ting 'dzin phrin las rnams// gting mtha' dpag med tshad bzung med par shog /'khor los sgyur rgyal dpag med bdag sprul nas// 'gro kun re skongs chos kyi rgyal srid skyong*// mkha' mnyam zhing khams kun la dbang bsgyur nas// sems can ma lus bde la 'god par shog /ma 'ongs dus su nad mtshon bskal pa yis// sems can sdug bsngal nyam thag gyur pa'i tshe// bdag ni sman mchog rgyal por gyur nas kyang*// skad cig nyid la sdug bsngal zhi byed (462)shog /mu ge'i bskal pas bkres skom gyur pa'i tshe// bza' btung dar zab gser dngul longs spyod rnams// phun sum tshogs pa mkha' mnyam sprin gtibs nas// phyogs bcur 'dod yon lnga yi char 'bebs shog /byang chub sems kyi spyod pa rlabs chen gyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par ma gyur tshe// nam mkha'i mtha' gtugs sems can ma lus kun// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston shog /log pa'i lam zhugs stobs ldan dregs pa can// phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal bas ma thul ba'i// 'gro kun ma lus bdag gis rab btul nas// skad cig nyid la sangs rgyas sar 'god shog

/ji srid 'khor bar sems can gnas kyi bar// de srid phrin las rtsol med rang shar gyis// sems can ma lus smin cing grol byed pa'i// 'gro don lhun grub rgyun chad med par shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho yi// so so skye bo byang chub sems dpa'i tshe// bskal pa grangs med sems bskyed smon lam btab// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin mngon par sangs rgyas nas// phun sum tshogs mnga' yon tan rgya mtsho yis// sems can dpag med smin cing grol mdzad pa'i// smon lam phrin las gcig tu bsdoms pa nas// bdag gi smon lam phrin las rgya cher shog /gzhan don lhun grub dpag med 'byung gyur pas// bdag gi smon lam 'di dag thams cad kun// byang chub mchog mos dad pa rab bskyed de// gang gis 'debs pa de la yongs rdzogs shog /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'khor 'das thams cad kyi// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa kun// rgyun chad med pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// bdag gzhan phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par shog
/'phags pa smon lam gyi rgyal po rdzogs so//
